name: table-export-menu
title: Table export menu
description: An Export menu for any table: download the rows as CSV or copy them for a spreadsheet, with no server involved.
docs: Describe the file with columns (a key, a header and an optional exportValue for raw values) and pass rows, or getRows to build them only when asked. The file is built in the browser: UTF-8 with a byte order mark for Excel, quotes escaped, hidden columns skipped. Use a semicolon delimiter for locales that write decimals with a comma, and onExported to show your own toast. After an export the button shows a check and one short word for a moment (the labels downloadedShort, copiedShort and so on), so the toolbar does not move; the whole line is announced to screen readers and set as the title.
